name: Haus Mitterhorn
beschreibung: The Haus Mitterhorn is situated in a quiet location in Tirol with a view of the surrounding mountain panorama. The holiday apartment is equipped with a fully equipped kitchen and comfortable living areas. There is no on-site dining option, but the kitchen allows flexible self-catering. Nearby, hiking trails in summer and ski slopes in winter invite you to activities. The house impresses with its quiet atmosphere, combining traditional alpine elements with modern living comfort.
